messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Realtime/streaming API p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2). SLO target p99 < 2s breached (observed p99 ~28s). Error count: 1.2k timeouts in last 10m. Paging oncall.

morgan (oncall): I'm on pager, looking. Any customer reports?

customer-ops: Support ticket #12345 from AcmeCorp: their UI shows 'connection lost' and partial transcripts. They saw timeouts starting ~00:14 UTC.

devon: Metrics: p95 jumped from 300ms -> 1.8s, p99 -> 28s. Streaming connection success rate down 85% -> 60%. Upstream proxy 504s spiked; many connections closed by proxy at ~30s.

alex: Debugging logs from gateway-12: repeated "write timeout" and "broken pipe" on streaming worker threads. KV-cache tail writes are queued, and chunk flushes stall. I see backlog growth in the per-connection write queue.

sara: Quick repro: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream` -> initial events then no chunks after ~12s, socket still open, no FIN. Client eventually gets restart/timeout from our front proxy at ~30s.

alex: Grep from gateway logs (snip):
```
[stream-worker] INFO  chunked-write: queued=432 flushed=7 stall=true
[network] WARN  upstream-reset: id=0x4f deadline=00:00:30
[proxy] ERROR downstream-504: client_timeout after 30s
```

devon: Envoy stats show `downstream_rq_time` long tails and `upstream_cx_idle_timeout` hits. Could be proxy buffering + slow consumer/backpressure.

oncall-bot: @morgan escalated to infra.

morgan (oncall): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Route affected tenants (AcmeCorp + list) to a streaming-gateway pool with increased keepalive and disabled proxy buffering. 2) Temporarily set fallback to non-streaming responses for affected tenants to avoid tail stalls (i.e., return final payload once complete). 3) Increase proxy upstream idle timeout to 65s to avoid premature 30s 504s while we stabilize.

infra: We're seeing a pattern where slow consumers cause write queues to back up and then proxy triggers timeout. Can scale gateway pool and reduce per-connection buffer defaults.

morgan (oncall): I'm applying route override for tenant=acmecorp -> route to streaming-hot pool. Applying: `rdctl route set --tenant acmecorp --streaming-pool streaming-hot --disable-proxy-buffering true`

alex: Adding rule to disable chunked flush coalescing on that pool. Also bumping gateway replicas by +3.

(2m later) oncall-bot: deploy-bot: route-change applied by morgan. gateway pool scaled to +3.

customer-ops: Notified AcmeCorp that we applied a temporary routing fix and a fallback option; they asked for ETA on full fix.

(5m later) devon: Metrics update: error rate falling. p99 down from 28s -> 3.8s, p95 back to ~650ms. Connections stabilized on streaming-hot pool. Some timeouts still hitting older gateways; we're draining them.

morgan (oncall): Temporarily enabled non-stream fallback for heavy sessions as of now for acmecorp and two other tenants. This reduces partial transcripts but avoids client-visible disconnects.

infra: Root cause hypothesis: client backpressure + proxy buffering + coalesced chunk flushes cause per-connection write queues to grow; once queue > threshold, worker stalls and upstream proxy eventually times out at 30s. Need permanent fix in streaming runtime to detect slow consumers earlier and apply backpressure throttling or drop/trim caches.

alex: Quick patch ideas: 1) early-shed slow consumers when write-queue depth > X; 2) proactive flush intervals on streaming path; 3) ensure upstream proxy timeouts aligned with expected streaming session lengths.

morgan (oncall): Current status: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced. Estimated full recovery in 30-60m while we drain old gateways.

customer-ops: AcmeCorp confirms improvement, UI reconnects successful, they see full transcripts for new sessions.

morgan (oncall): Post-incident actions (assigned):
- Alex: postmortem and timeline (72h)
- Infra: add alert for gateway write-queue > 500 (owner: infra)
- Devex: add e2e slow-consumer test to CI (owner: devex)
- Product/Support: follow-up note to AcmeCorp + SLA credit review (owner: customer-ops)

devon: Also adding a monitoring check: p99 streaming latency > 5s -> page pager. Current runbook updated with quick route-override recipe.

morgan (oncall): Closing pager for now, leaving incident thread open for postmortem prep. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
